## Codex runtime mapping

Use native task history and verified rollout paths, not `~/.cursor/projects`. Preserve the scope window, distinct own-history/shared-record sweep, citations, live-state readback and capsule format. Apply the standing model router to optional read-only delegation.
codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
preserved_requirement: Reconstruct your recent working context from your own chat history, live state, and the shared record (user reports, prior fixes, incidents), then hand back a tight current-state brief. Use for 'recall my work on X', 'catch me up', 'what have I been working on', 'where did I leave off', before starting or resuming work.
proof: A bounded fixture reconciles an exact workspace/topic against a selected prior record, live repository state and a matching shared record without writes; it excludes the current task and marks missing or mismatched exports partial. Native task-history selection and a full `cursor-why` shared-record sweep remain unproven.
reason: Port Cursor-only delegation, model and context storage to native Codex while retaining the upstream workflow and evidence contract.

replacements.before: Transcripts live at `~/.cursor/projects/<slug>/agent-transcripts/<uuid>/<uuid>.jsonl`, where `<slug>` is the workspace path with the leading slash dropped and each "/" turned into "-" (so `/Users/you/proj` becomes `Users-you-proj`). Every line is one chat message.
replacements.after: In Codex, discover accessible prior tasks with the native thread list/read tools. Local rollout JSONL may provide full tool history when a verified rollout path is available; its filesystem layout varies by host. Do not infer a Cursor transcript path or read a different project without the user’s scope.

replacements.before: Spawn parallel subagents on a fast, cheap model, each taking a slice of the corpus.
replacements.after: For a large in-scope corpus, delegate independent slices to read-only Codex subagents under the standing `model-capability-router` policy.

replacements.before: Tell every subagent to order candidates by real modification time (`ls -t`) and never by UUID name, grep the topic first and then read only the matching chats and only their relevant regions, and skip the current chat plus obvious noise (subagent, eval, and test chats).
replacements.after: Tell each investigator to order accessible tasks by verified update time, search the topic before opening a transcript, read only relevant regions, and skip the current task plus obvious eval/test noise. Do not assume a filename UUID encodes recency.
